camera.camera_motion_or_bookmark_sequence: fixed bookmark: identical pose at every declared cover tick
camera.state_or_tick_interval: composed tick_interval [1, 289]; T-segment replay ticks 1..229 (band_mid|n=3); R-segment replay ticks mapped to composed 230..259 (scene|n=3, composed = 229 + replay tick); frames at the declared story beats [4, 8, 20, 31, 60, 120, 186, 193, 208, 250]; one tick = 0.005 s (M06 DT); COMPOSED AXIS: ticks 1..229 are the T-segment band_mid|n=3 replay ticks, ticks 230..289 are the R-segment scene|n=3 replay ticks 1..60 (composed = 229 + replay tick); frames are the declared story beats at 1 video second per frame; the rendered states are bound to experiment_trace.json story rows of the two declared scenarios

state_binding.note: the ASSEMBLED composition story: the T segment is the sealed G06 band_mid|n=3 229-tick transfer replay (attach at the source band, load (climb-to-friction handover), hold, the handover at tick 31 (holders carry m/(n-1)), the accel/cruise/brake/hover climb to the target band, re-attach at tick 193, hold2, release at 220), then the R segment is the sealed G07 scene|n=3 release story (the release flag flips exactly at replay tick 21, composed tick 250); every frame is bound to a REAL replay tick of a REAL certified run through the declared tick_map (composed axis 1..289); the diagnostic layer draws the delivered telemetry (tick/phase/dt, all-stick and holding-stick counts, support flag) at the declared story beats; identical state_hash across the pair
